facts.claim: 蜗牛警卫 Eddie 慢吞吞地把 Kay 与我领到女监区，他们得以落后几步低声私谈。
facts.quote: Eddie the smelly snail guard slid along at his glacial pace

facts.claim: Kay 自我介绍并说明来意后，正在打电话骂人的辅导员 Martina Becerra 态度骤变，起身带路。
facts.quote: Martina Becerra’s tune changed when Kay introduced us

facts.claim: Martina 一坐下就断言 Deedee 既没有自杀也没有意外过量，绝无可能。
facts.quote: Deedee didn’t kill herself. Or accidentally OD. There’s no way.

facts.claim: Martina 透露受害者 Genevieve 的母亲 Cheryl Spruce 曾多次来探视 Deedee。
facts.quote: You know Genevieve’s mother visited Deedee? Multiple times.

facts.claim: Martina 记得最后一次探视就在复活节后，约六周前，且只有那位同伴独自前来。
facts.quote: it was just after Easter, so it had to be about six weeks ago

facts.claim: Martina 说 Genevieve 在证人听证会上明显心不在焉，因此假释小组这次才敢逆着她的意思放人。
facts.quote: Her heart wasn’t in it though. Not the way it usually was.

facts.claim: Deirdre 的长期安置计划是投靠圣迭戈的表亲、考美容师执照、在呼叫中心先做一份工。
facts.quote: She had a cousin in San Diego who was willing to take her in

facts.claim: Martina 说 Deirdre 最执着的是攀岩墙：她争取多年让监狱装了标准岩壁，能飞快登顶。
facts.quote: There was one last activity she wanted to do before she left. The rock wall.

relations.rel: 调查者与被访者：Kay 说明来意后 Martina 转为全力配合，提供案情内情。
relations.quote: Kay introduced us and told her why we were here

relations.rel: 假释辅导员与当事人：共事六年，坚称她不会自伤。
relations.quote: I’ve been working with her for six years, okay?

relations.rel: 受害者 Genevieve 的母亲，多年多次到监狱探视她并表达宽恕。
relations.quote: You know Genevieve’s mother visited Deedee? Multiple times.

relations.rel: 常与 Cheryl 同来的女伴，最后一次是独自探视，约六周前。
relations.quote: That was just the companion though.

relations.rel: 受害者本人，坚持每场听证会到场并反对假释。
relations.quote: a hundred percent Genevieve Caraway’s right to come to every single hearing

relations.rel: 名义上的丈夫，在狱中从无往来，她出狱当天请求见他被拒。
relations.quote: Deedee put in a request to see him on the day of her release

numbers.claim: Martina 与 Deedee 共事的年数。
numbers.quote: I’ve been working with her for six years, okay?

numbers.claim: Cheryl 与同伴多年来探视的次数。
numbers.quote: I don’t have the exact number but I’d say four, five, over the years?

numbers.claim: 最后一次探视距当时的时长（复活节后）。
numbers.quote: it was just after Easter, so it had to be about six weeks ago

numbers.claim: 会议室长桌可坐的人数。
numbers.quote: a stuffy, windowless room with a conference table big enough to seat twenty

numbers.claim: 桌上环形水渍足以凑出两个奥运五环标志。
numbers.quote: make at least two Olympic insignias

numbers.claim: Martina 拿进会议室的瓶装水数量。
numbers.quote: She took three, putting one in front of each of us

numbers.claim: Deirdre 攀爬那面岩壁的次数（夸张说法）。
numbers.quote: She must have done it a thousand times.

numbers.claim: 她离开前想做的最后一项活动（攀岩墙）的数量。
numbers.quote: There was one last activity she wanted to do before she left.

numbers.claim: Kay 对“最近一次探视”时间范围的上限估计。
numbers.quote: So that was sometime in the last six months?

numbers.claim: 圣迭戈表亲愿意收留她的最短期限。
numbers.quote: willing to take her in for at least the first year she was out

numbers.claim: Martina 一口气喝掉的水量。
numbers.quote: Martina guzzled half of hers, the bottle crunching noisily.

numbers.claim: 她获释次日即死亡的时间间隔。
numbers.quote: how does that translate into suicide a day later?

numbers.claim: Martina 强调 Genevieve 到场听审是完全正当的权利。
numbers.quote: And it was a hundred percent Genevieve Caraway’s right
The woman looked to be in her early thirties

turning_point: Martina 说出 Deirdre 的头号爱好是攀岩墙——她争取多年让监狱装了标准岩壁、能飞快登顶——这让 Kay 与我立刻想到 Sweet Spot 露台外那道直落悬崖，暗示她不是自杀，而是攀上崖顶离开。
notes: 1) 那位“同伴”应是 Rose Tillohash，但本章只由 Kay 反问“Was this other woman Native American?”与叙述者内心推测坐实，Martina 本人从未说出姓名；2) Kay 对 Martina 谎称 Deirdre 的死因仍在按过量调查（原文用 fibbed），故 Martina 的证词是在被隐瞒部分真相下给出的；3) 关于 Eli Pratt 的模拟画像与 Luke Fulton（“Austin Whisperer”）的段落为旁支信息，未列入主干 facts；4) Martina 承认自己私下带 Deirdre 去男监区远远看了 Austin 一眼，属违规行为，她的叙述因此可能有所保留。
